story.label: The Firm
story.title: We didn't set out to start a firm.
story.teaser: It began inside our own businesses — the messy, cross-cutting problems no single expert would own. We kept solving them, kept getting asked to do the same for others, and eventually said yes. That's all this is: a few people who are good at finding the problem everyone else walked past.

experts.label: The Experts
experts.title: A circle of experts we bring in when it helps.

ourStory.title: A bench, not a solo act.
ourStory.intro: Independent expert advisory, built as a bench — not a solo act, and not a big-firm pyramid.
body: G A Sheth & Associates is the vehicle: an independent advisory firm assembled from a bench of practitioners across software, finance, operations and strategy. We exist for the problems that fall between the seams — the ones every specialist you called passed on because they were only ever part of the answer.

We take one problem at a time, point the right people at it together, and stay only as long as we are useful. No retainers by default, no interest in keeping you dependent — a clear read, a decision you can act on, and a way forward you own.

person.name: Gitanj Sheth
person.lead: An operator and builder, not a career consultant. Gitanj has run and fixed real businesses from inside a business family — pairing an owner's instinct for what actually moves a company with an engineer's rigour and a strategist's read of where it's headed.
person.combination: A rare mix — engineering, management and computer science — backed by a real operating record, not a corporate career spent watching from a desk.

person.pedigree: From an established, multi-company business family; a director across several of its companies.
person.why: Having solved hard problems across his own family's businesses — and for the people around him — he now brings that same outside, first-principles eye to other people's toughest problems. For the problem, not the fee.
person.selectivity: A limited number of engagements, chosen for the problem worth solving. The first conversation is free.

solutions.title: Two reasons people bring us in.
solutions.intro: There's no fixed menu of services. It usually comes down to one of two things — and the real problem is often deeper than the symptom that made you call.

repair.label: Repair
repair.body: Something's leaking — money, time, or quality — and what you've already tried hasn't held. You need the real fault found, not the obvious one patched again.

boost.label: Boost
boost.body: The business works, but it isn't compounding the way it should. You want the next level, and a clear, honest route to reach it.

solutions.casesLink: See the kind of problems we've untangled
solutions.note: If you already know exactly what's broken and how to fix it, you don't need us.

engage.title: How we engage
engage.intro: No price list. Just a plain account of how working with G A Sheth & Associates begins and how consideration is decided.

points.heading: The first call is free.
points.body: We start with a conversation, at no charge, to understand the problem and tell you honestly whether we're the right people for it.

points.heading: No upfront charge, no commitment.
points.body: You are not asked to pay to begin, and you are not locked into continuing. We earn the next step, or we don't.

points.heading: Travel only at actuals.
points.body: If the problem needs us on the ground, you cover travel and stay at actuals — nothing marked up, nothing hidden.

points.heading: Consideration decided together.
points.body: Scope and fees are agreed mutually once value is on the table, in proportion to what the work is worth to you.
